newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's ASB Bank lifts March qtr profit by 37 pct.
newsitem.headline: NZ's ASB Bank lifts March qtr profit by 37 pct.

text.p: ASB Bank's New Zealand arm on Monday reported a March quarter profit of NZ$26.3 million, up 37 percent on the same quarter last year.

ASB said its after-tax operating profit for the nine months to March 31 was $66.7 million. The bank said the unaudited nine-month result was up 27 perent on that achieved in the same period last year.
ASB Bank is 75 percent-owned by the Commonwealth Bank of Australia.
"ASB has achieved strong, sustained growth nationally across the business, rural and retail banking sectors, significantly lifting its 1996/97 financial performance," ASB said in a statement.

Total assets at March 31 had increased to $10.3 billion, up 21 percent over the past 12 months. ASB said the quality of such assets remained sound, with a reduction in total impaired assets and an increase in specific provisions compared with March 31, 1996.
